## Abstract

This thesis investigates ethnic and socioeconomic differences in access to medication and use of healthcare services among US Medicare beneficiaries. Using the 2013 and 2020 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey public-use files, I combine descriptive comparisons and chi-square tests with multivariable logistic regressions adjusting for age, gender, education, health, and insurance coverage.
